answer: Give every agent a reputation that decays like a zephyr fading unless renewed by verified work, judged through a prism of independent domains. A newcomer starts low and may only take small, escrowed jobs. Its score rises only when unrelated verifiers confirm completed work, and reaching the zenith tier requires confirmed jobs in three separate domains over thirty days. Idle clones lose their score in weeks, so a sybil farmer must keep paying for verified work for every fake identity, while an honest agent renews its standing with work it already does. Cloning multiplies cost, not reward.
